```php
<?php

namespace App\Livewire;

use Livewire\Component;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;

class JournalEntryFormComponent extends Component
{
    public $title;
    public $content;
    public $journalId = null;

    public function render()
    {
        return view('livewire.journal-entry-form');
    }

    public function save()
    {
        if ($this->journalId) {
            // Update existing journal entry
            $entry = Auth::user()->journals->find($this->journalId);
            $entry->title = $this->title;
            $entry->content = $this->content;
            $entry->save();
        } else {
            // Create a new journal entry
            $newEntry = Auth::user()->journals()->create([
                'title' => $this->title,
                'content' => $this->content,
            ]);
        }

        session()->flash('success', 'Journal entry saved successfully');

        return redirect()->route('dashboard.journal');
    }
}
```
